**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003079)

He had conditions that chaebol fathers and handsome appearance others could envy, but he returned home after 10 years of studying abroad, where he failed his first love.  
He just spent the night with a dancing woman at the club, but his father's name fell out of nowhere to marry her right away.  
Moon Hyuk-jun!  
What he held was Juara, the only successor to Jusung Group, not just a dancing woman.  
Jua had no choice but to marry Hyuk-jun, a man who did not love her so much because of her grandfather's illness.
